Every number in the results table comes from a trained model that was saved as a **checkpoint**, a file of weights. This page lists the checkpoints behind each benchmark: the parameters, the SHA-256 of the weights and the value `reproduce.py` gives from them (Reproduced). Open *Configuration and training* under a table for the architecture and the training settings. The checkpoints of the experimental GIWO are on [their own page](experimental.md).

The SHA-256 is that of the weights file: the table shows its first 12 characters, and the full value is in the details and in the [checkpoint inventory](../checkpoint_inventory.csv). Code is licensed LGPL-3.0-only; the licence of the weights is on their Hugging Face repository (Download column). To reproduce the numbers, see [Reproduce our benchmarks](../reproducibility.md).
